# Windsurf / Devin Desktop changelog — captured 2026-08-14
# https://docs.devin.ai/desktop/changelog
# (sources.json still has windsurf.com/changelog -> 308, and docs.windsurf.com -> 307. Both wrong.)

### v3.7.16 — August 10, 2026   [NEW; cache previously at v3.6.27. Held below the watching bar.]
Desktop: restart-to-update now confirms when local agents are active and states how many will be
stopped; settings and keyboard shortcuts open as regular editor tabs; **"Plugins" renamed to
"Extensions"**; Agent Command Center visual polish.
Local agents: **Share Conversation uploads a sanitized transcript** and produces a team-visible link;
reverting mid-turn made reliable; **the Customizations panel gains a search box and a new Subagents
section**; **permission rules from different hierarchy levels now compose predictably, with explicit
denials taking priority**; sudo password prompts no longer hang commands; **each MCP server's logs
are separated into distinct output channels**.
Cloud sessions: session size chips use enterprise ACU thresholds; queued messages editable; collapsed
agent-group diff summaries open a multi-diff editor.

[Assessment: watching tier admits only MAJOR new capabilities. These are refinements of features
already inventoried — subagents and MCP already existed, and Share Conversation is a transcript
export. Two are worth remembering if Devin Desktop is ever brought into ENDPOINT scope: the
**sanitized-transcript share link** (an outbound content path from a local coding agent) and the
**permission-rule hierarchy with deny precedence** (a policy model Zenity would need to evaluate).
Recorded, not reported.]

Updated: 2026-08-14 — version advanced 3.6.27 -> 3.7.16; nothing above the bar.
